craft_notes: Sthāyin: fancy-as-fuel (inverse of p06's burnt-fancy: here fancy FULLY offered). Rows: row 3 (at-once→rise). Close: rise (mahodaya #4 — refrain cluster: v28/29/57/63). Rejected: 'all-body awareness' — kept consciousness-made (the compound means the body IS made of it, not awareness-of-it); 'imagination' — killed: fancy kept (vikalpa as charged term).

lines: All body consciousness-made, or world, fancy fully:
at once by undivided mind — supreme rise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ dehaṃ cinmayaṃ hi jagad vā paribhāvayet | yugapan nirvikalpena manasā paramodayaḥ

reads_against.argmap: How does the supreme rise come? → Undivided fancy of all-body-as-consciousness yields supreme rise.
c1_essence: All-body fancy: undivided mind, supreme rise.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta charged with vīra (wonder armed with intensity)
